asked_by: Madhav, 2 Nov 2026 19:05 Toronto (in chat), after reviewing a Vivek Bajaj / order-block video write-up: "Yes , set it up." (a registered test of relative strength against the Nifty on Indian stocks)
title: Relative strength: do the liquid stocks beating the Nifty most keep beating the average stock?
hypothesis: Among the 250 most-traded stocks, those in the top tenth by their return relative to the Nifty over the last 6 months (or 3 months) earn more than the average liquid stock over the next 20 (or 60) sessions after delivery costs; the bottom tenth earns less.
what_was_tried_before: Relative strength was tested only inside other setups, as Trade With Trend cards (25 Oct): RS line at a high on breakouts (H13), RS new high before price (H14), leaders' 50-day pullbacks (H09), stage 2 (H27), correction leaders (H28), selling weak losers in pullbacks (H26). All REJECTED or INCONCLUSIVE; several were positive in 2018-23 and flat or negative in 2000-17. The plain cross-sectional ranking was never tested. Those 151 teacher variants count in this study's bar.

data.stock_panel: gold/teachers/stock_panel.parquet, rows dated before 2024-01-01 only (rs_ret126 and rs_ret63 = the stock's close over the Nifty 500, its change over 126 / 63 sessions; liq_rank; net20 / net60 = forward return after delivery costs; dist_sma50; nifty_below_both)

definitions.universe: each session, stocks with liq_rank <= 250 and a known ranking value
definitions.top10: the stock's rank by the ranking value among that session's universe is in the top tenth (percentile >= 0.90)
definitions.nochase: top10 by rs126 and dist_sma50 <= 0.08 (the paper book's no-chase line: not more than 8% above the 50-day average)
definitions.nifty_down: the session's Nifty is below both its 50- and 200-day averages (nifty_below_both); signal and base both restricted to those sessions
definitions.outcome: net20 or net60 as named (after delivery costs)

statistics.level: india.teachers_stock.level: per calendar quarter, the signal rows' mean outcome minus all universe rows' mean outcome in the same quarter; t across quarters
statistics.verdict: india/registry.record standard rule (both periods, family bar)

bar.note: the 151 Trade With Trend variants (relative strength was tried there) plus these 6; k frozen at 157

not_claimed: Research only; no rule changes. A pass would become a proposal (a shadow paper trial against random picks and the market, then Madhav's yes), never a direct rule.
